Practical GM help: links provide complete rules. Situational decisions and unsupported effects remain adjudicated.

  1. Check player ownership, genre/options and content language. Keep private campaign notes outside these published resources.
  2. Open the linked preparation/presentation procedures for native Journal sharing. Open an actor sheet below for existing GM controls; this shortcut alone spends nothing.

  1. Agree intent, need for a roll, stat and base difficulty. Declare applicable circumstances and avoid duplicating modifiers already supplied by the sheet.
  2. Use the linked difficulty/Effort/special-roll cards and full exceptions. The task aid below opens the normal dialog. Distinguish the original card's paid reroll from a GM-approved fresh attempt with paid Effort.

  2. Advance real turns and confirm waiting triggers, range and movement explicitly. Open the NPC sheet below to launch its attack and use that attack's defense workflow.

  1. Check which consequence has already been applied: NPC Health, PC wounds/Pools, shield track or Object level. Do not resolve the same hit twice.
  2. Follow the linked wound/rest cards and full shield/object rules. Open the actual sheet for dedicated damage, recovery or treatment controls; declare time, tools and protection first.

  1. Declare actual conditions, exposure and protection. Hazard names supply no universal damage table; save then trigger the explicit profile. Ending exposure does not heal its consequences.
  2. Choose one cooperative mode per task/attack and check the global asset cap. Confirm guard eligibility and follower help separately through the actual sheet's general actions.

  1. Describe the intrusion and use the PC sheet or retained natural 1 card. Finish the mandatory XP recipient choice and decide player requests on their cards.
  2. Keep cards and receipts. Resume an interrupted settlement rather than awarding twice. Inspect reroll corrections before manual edits; narrative effects still need explicit resolution.

  1. Preview below to inspect a result; use the recipient PC sheet's Generate/Award controls for an actual grant after checking capacity, power and variant.
  2. Draw, award and Use are distinct. Check the linked complete definition and existing target changes before resolving an unsupported particular effect manually.

Practical GM help: links provide complete rules. Situational decisions and unsupported effects remain adjudicated.

  1. Discuss arc/story XP, record agreed awards and avoid duplicating intrusion settlement. Review dedicated advancement choices and already-applied resource/follower rewards.
  2. Open the principal PC's project panel. Review qualification, total shared cost, participants and time; complete only after actual work. Resume or reconcile interrupted completion instead of paying again.
